  Codex can now safely edit files and execute commands in your computer

• Model changed to glm-5.3-flash medium for Plan mode.

• Model changed to glm-5.3-flash high for Default mode.

  Update Model Permissions


  1. Read Only                                       Codex can read files in the
                                                     current workspace. Approval
                                                     is required to edit files
                                                     or access the internet.
› 2. Ask for approval (non-admin sandbox) (current)  Codex can read and edit
                                                     files in the current
                                                     workspace, and run
                                                     commands. Approval is
                                                     required to access the
                                                     internet or edit other
                                                     files.
  3. Approve for me                                  Only ask for actions
                                                     detected as potentially
                                                     unsafe.
  4. Full Access                                     Codex can edit files
                                                     outside this workspace and
                                                     access the internet without
                                                     asking for approval.
                                                     Exercise caution when
                                                     using.

  The non-admin sandbox protects your files and prevents network access under
  most circumstances. However, it carries greater risk if prompt injected. To
  upgrade to the default sandbox, run /setup-default-sandbox.
